# JooEvents

> JooEvents helps organizers run proposals, review, speakers, schedules, and the operational details around an event. This public site is a product overview, not an agent-direct surface or the API origin for a particular installation.

## External API integration

- [Connect through the API](https://docs.jooevents.com/agents/quickstart.md): Safely configure a third-party agent for one JooEvents installation.
- [External API operating model](https://docs.jooevents.com/agents/operating-model.md): Direct reads, human-approved plans, availability, and recovery.
- [External API recipes](https://docs.jooevents.com/agents/recipes.md): Discovery-first sequences for common agent work.
- [API documentation index](https://docs.jooevents.com/llms.txt): The concise map of public JooEvents API documentation.

## Product

- [Product walkthrough](https://jooevents.com/): Public overview and demo entry point.

## Optional

- [Licensing](https://docs.jooevents.com/reference/licensing.md): License information for this release.
